steps.name: Traces of the Missing Goddess
steps.objective: Go to the front of 「Sanctum of the Covenant」 and meet [Iris]. After seeing what happens, turn in the quest to [Minuet] in 「Adrica」.

lines.text: (Upon reaching the Sanctum of the Covenant deep within Eidos, a breeze as warm as Iris's touch blows past.)
(Following the breeze to a small path behind the sanctum, you suddenly seem to recall last night's dream.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure I dreamed something, but I can't remember any of it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go see Iris. She is calling me, isn't she?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What could it be? Nothing seems urgent right now...
(A tiny light arrives with the wind and carries the visitor away.)
(As the approaching light fades, Iris appears with a radiant smile.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I was thinking how much I wanted to see you. I didn't expect you to come like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought you might be calling me...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You could have simply spoken to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. Ahaha. I suppose I could have.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There's something I need to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Let's go see Minuet.
(Iris carefully takes %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There's something I need to check with her, as Lady Gaia's incarnation.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: So hold on tight. I don't know how we'll land this time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hm?
(Iris smiles mischievously at %s's reaction.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll be hurt if you look so alarmed. Don't be too nervous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: R-right.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Shall we?
(After a few steps with Iris, a familiar place comes into view. Familiar cries greet them as creatures approach.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Oh, so many beautiful, adorable mythical beasts!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Adrica. Do you like animals, Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, as long as they don't attack first. I was bitten and hurt quite often during my travels.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me too. These little ones thought I was bad at first. They followed me around, poking and biting me.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's only natural to be wary of someone unfamiliar.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There are people they're especially fond of, though. Like Lady Levi...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe because she's kind?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hehe, perhaps. Oh, there's Minuet.
(In the distance, Minuet stands gazing blankly ahead.)
(Minuet recognizes them, blinks, and waves in greeting.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet? Her mouth is moving, but I can't hear her voice...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Just as I thought...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Perhaps because Lady Gaia has gone so far away, she isn't connected to Minuet. Minuet says she's fine, but...
(Minuet looks at Iris with a slightly vacant gaze.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: A god's absence must affect their incarnation, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet...
(Minuet takes %s's hand and blinks.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, do you know where Lady Gaia is? You said she'd gone far away.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Ah... Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please tell me.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It seems she came back briefly to see Lord Atkina, then left again. That's how I found out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know why she did that?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm not certain, but I think she wanted to lend me her strength. I want to speak with her, too, but...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: She went to a refuge between Etoile and another world... I can't leave this place unattended.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could someone go in your place?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me. Please.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes. I promised not to hide things from you, so I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's possible. But dangerous. For an ordinary person, that place is a tangle of countless times and souls...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's dangerous! To go there in a human body...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go see Lady Gaia. She might be waiting.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Even so...
(Iris trails off, then looks resigned.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll allow it. Just this once.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: When you're ready, come near the entrance to the Sanctum of the Covenant. I'll prepare as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Minuet... Please wish %s good luck.
(Minuet nods in understanding. Iris smiles softly, then quietly disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Iris is that worried, it must be dangerous. I'd better prepare carefully. I'll be going, Minuet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll make sure to find Lady Gaia...

steps.name: Where Gaia Is
steps.objective: Return to the front of 「Sanctum of the Covenant」 and travel to the new area. Then turn in the quest to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」.

lines.text: (Once your preparations are complete, you arrive at the sanctum's entrance. A breeze like Iris's touch blows once more.)
(Unlike before, however, it comes and goes unsteadily.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...?

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: I'm fine. It's a power I've never used before. I'm just not accustomed to it.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: %s, let me ask once more. Are you still certain you want to go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I haven't changed my mind.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: Close your eyes. I'll send you there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Close your eyes as Iris asks.)

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: The place your footsteps must reach, %s, holds a time different from this one... Between the boundaries of time and space...

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: Pneuma...
(Iris's voice grows faint, then falls silent. Suddenly, everything in %s's view seems to distort.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what...?
(Everything ahead repeatedly twists and returns to normal, then stops. After some time, you lift your head to find an unfamiliar space within the darkness.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where am I...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't hear her voice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think there's light over there. Is that the way out? I'd better look.
(Following the light, %s enters an unfamiliar space. Yet the air feels strangely familiar.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've definitely never seen this place before...
(A beautiful coastline unfolds in the moonlight. Small stars fall one by one above clouds that seem to encircle the island.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A beach...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've never seen a beach like this in Jiendia, Freios, or Eastland...
(Small waves rise in time with the cool breeze. With each wave, hidden beings emerge and roam about.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Spirits?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...They just walk past, untroubled by me. Where are they going?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I follow? Who's that over there?

steps.name: A Place Full of Spirits (1)
steps.objective: Defeat [Green Atmos] and [Kind Aerura] in 「Pneuma」, then turn in the quest to [Arche].

lines.text: (Following spirits unlike any seen elsewhere leads to a quiet place where a girl stands.)
(Standing in the moonlight, the girl greets the spirits with bright eyes.)
You're back. Did you have fun?
Don't try to bite me, even as a joke. I'd really hate to be bitten to death.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me...
A spirit I haven't seen before.
(The girl pats the spirits' heads, then %s's. Sensing something strange, she pats it again and looks puzzled.)
This is definitely hair...
Hair?!
Aaaah! A-a person!
(The girl jumps back in alarm.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please don't be scared. I'm not a bad person. Though saying that makes me sound like one... Anyway, I'm not!
...S-sorry. It's rude to be frightened by someone. I just haven't seen a person in so long... Who are you?
(The girl regains her composure and stares at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My name is %s... %s.
%s. So you're %s. I'm Arche, and I live here in Pneuma. A pretty name, isn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a lovely name.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I've heard a great deal about you, %s. Or rather, I've learned a great deal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Well... Even if I stay here, spirits who visit the world below tell me things. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does that mean you're a spirit? A Spirit King? They seem to like you... Or are you Lady Gaia's incarnation?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: No. I'm neither a spirit nor an incarnation. Just an ordinary human. Though it's strange that I can't leave and only live here, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Hehe. The rest is a secret.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A secret...?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Oh dear. The spirits seem startled by your unfamiliar energy, %s. Could you play with them over there?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Just fight them as you would spar with Valdrick.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know Valdrick?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Let's discuss that later. If you wait too long, the spirits might take your hand, %s, and put you somewhere strange, neither the Abyss nor Purgatory.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Then you'd never see the light again.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Those are this place's rules. Even I can't change them, though I live here. Spirits have their rules, and humans have theirs.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It shouldn't be difficult. Go play with them. I'll wait here.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: ...Then I'll tell you about Lady Iris and Lady Gaia. Oops, that's a secret.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This seems a little suspicious... I don't know if it's true, but I have no choice.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back.

steps.name: A Place Full of Spirits (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Doctor Theoria] and [Action Praxis] in 「Pneuma」, then turn in the quest to [Arche].

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You played nicely with the spirits. They look happy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It wasn't quite like sparring with Valdrick... Now, tell me about Iris and Lady Gaia.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Before that, aren't you curious about this place?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said it's called Pneuma? I think that's what Iris said...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's a secret, but... This is Pneuma, also called the 'Space of Breath.' It influences those in Etoile who spend their time in what we call 'life.'

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You see the spirits here?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: They work hard to create positive signals. They make good times and convey good feelings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So it's definitely different from the time and space I live in? You mentioned rules earlier...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes. The flow itself is different.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it a world of spirits? The Spirit Realm?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: There are many spirits, but I wouldn't quite call it that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't understand any of this...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, it feels so comfortable here. Peaceful.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: There is no ill energy here because of the protection the ancient gods left behind.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: But that doesn't mean you may stay. If you linger like this, you won't be able to return to your original time.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Oh, that's a secret...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How much of this is a secret?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's no secret that Lady Gaia is here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: May I see her?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I can tell you where she is, but you can't reach her with your own strength, %s.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I don't know if you're aware, but Lady Gaia is here... Hm?
(An enormous number of spirits suddenly swarms toward them.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Oh dear. I think you'll have to calm them again. You must have some power that draws spirits to you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm just a human...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: An ordinary human wouldn't have come all the way here to speak with a goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do, then?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: ...Play with them one more time. As though you're taking a blast of Lord Atkina's dragon breath.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Wouldn't that kill me?
(Arche pushes %s toward the spirits.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Please hurry. It's the only way to settle time here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does 'settle time' even mean? Anyway, one more round of playing, and that's it, right?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes. Have fun with the spirits!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels like a test, but I'll do it. Then give me a proper explanation.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: See you soon!

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: (Just as Lady Gaia said...)

steps.name: To Preserve Everyday Life
steps.objective: Defeat [Chronos] in 「Chronos's Time」. Then turn in the quest to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Well done. The spirits seem satisfied again.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Though you look a little tired...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...That was a bit harder this time.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Sit here and rest a moment. While you do, Pneuma, the Space of Breath, will prepare to welcome you, %s.
(Arche quietly reaches toward the sky. The stars falling toward the sea stop, then disappear.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What a beautiful sky...)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Now, let me explain.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: As you know, %s, Lady Gaia exhausted her power for the star she loves, and for those dear to her.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: She has been recovering by sleeping and waking in cycles. When awake, she uses her power only where it is needed.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: But much has happened to her lately. Her sanctum was invaded, and she repeatedly faced those targeting Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Has something happened to her...?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: As time passes, the star slowly forgets Lady Gaia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Forgets her?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's a secret, but I'll tell you, %s.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Nothing lasts forever. Every object and every life has its allotted time. Even our beloved star, Etoile...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Even if the star itself does not vanish, it forgets the ancient gods who were with it. Only a handful remain now...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Whenever the star loses its memory of an ancient god, evil beings will come again.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: When Lady Gaia took the form of her incarnation, Minuet, if you hadn't come there, %s...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: And if you hadn't saved her from Barbatos in Eidos, that would have happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The star forgets its gods... Do the gods forget the star, too? Ah...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Barbatos said he'd lost his memories.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You keep saying it's a secret, Arche, but you tell me everything. Just how much do you know?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's fine. Even with secrets, I can tell you a certain amount. I've spent a long time under the influence of the flow of time, here between its currents.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: That's the kind of place Pneuma is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, can I see Lady Gaia now?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You need permission from the spirits responsible for the two spaces within the realm of time that flows through life.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Only then can you visit Lady Gaia, who is between those spaces.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Two time spirits, Chronos and Kairos, divide the space between them and guard it. Go speak with them.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: They will probably recognize you as someone blessed by Lady Gaia, %s... That's all I can tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll try.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Go see Chronos first. He is within a space named after him: 'Chronos's Time.'

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Go to that tent down there. That's the place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go meet him now. See you later.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'll wait here.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: (...Lady Gaia, will %s truly be able to stop time?)
(Entering the tent in the direction Arche indicated reveals a landscape quite different from Pneuma.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this place...?
(Beyond enormous stuffed animals taller than the forest's trees, a violet sunset colors the sky. A strange Ferris wheel turns before them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait... I thought this was a realm of time. Why is it... an amusement park?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No one's riding that Ferris wheel. Does it run all night?
No, hoot!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hoot?
(With that strange cry, an enormous bird descends from the sky. Unlike any ordinary bird, it stares intently at %s's face.)
Even a human cherished by a god cannot come here. Hoot!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An owl?
I may look like an owl, but I'm not one. Hoot! I am Chronos, a spirit of time. Hoot!
(An owl... or rather, an owl-shaped clock, introduces itself with one wing folded across its belly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So that's why he looks like a clock...?)
Tick. Tock.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He even ticks like a clock.)

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: %s! Good to see you, hoot! You're with Lady Iris, so speak freely. Hoot!
Oh, right. The reason I'm here...

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I know why you're here, hoot. You've come to see Lady Gaia.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: But, hoot!
(Chronos thrusts his scythe in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: What do you think? Hoot! I'm simply doing my duty as this space's keeper. Hoot!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need your permission to see Lady Gaia. Please grant it. Stop the time flowing here.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Stop time? What do you think would happen where Lady Iris is if time stopped here? Hoot?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, this place and that world...

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: ...Though that doesn't mean there's no way. Hoot...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me how!
(Chronos lowers his scythe and points at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Feel all the time within this space.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Feel time?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Don't take the flow of time lightly. Hoot! I manage this place, but there's a reason I can't do as I please!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: This place is structured to help all life in Etoile maintain its ordinary, everyday time. Hoot!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: The other spirits here work to make that time precious, too. Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what should I do?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Feel it with your whole body, hoot! Experience that time and come find me. Then I'll consider it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I knew it wouldn't be easy. I'll try.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Is that so, hoot? You've resolved to stop this time? From now on, this space, and every spirit within it, will obstruct you. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Understood, hoot?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood, hoot... I mean, understood.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Don't copy me, hoot! Do you think I'm an owl, too? Hoot?
(The bell on Chronos's head gives a brief ring. Looking almost angry, he gazes into the distance.)

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Owl or not, I'm busy. Come find me. Hoot.
(Chronos beats his wings vigorously and rises into the sky, then flies somewhere beyond the hill.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The flow of time...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go. The spirits are already gathering. I'll just have to make my way through...
(After escaping the pursuing spirits and reaching a quiet space, the adventurer hears a clock ticking.)
Tick. Tock.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chronos?
(As soon as his name is called, an enormous shadow descends. Chronos, the giant owl-clock spirit, regards the adventurer with the same sullen expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you looking at me like that?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: That's just my face, hoot. I can't help how I look. Hoot. The one who cherished me liked owls... Of all things...

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Sigh... Hoooot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Come to think of it, I remember you saving the flow of time from going awry. Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I did?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: A human was once turned into a clock by some power, wasn't he? Hoot?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... You mean the magic academy festival.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: The magic stones that villain Weiss used penetrated part of the 'time' I inhabit. Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: They made a hole, and the flow within leaked out, affecting Windy Seed. That fellow Zephyros even became a clock. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: It caused me plenty of trouble. Arche scolded me a lot, too. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: The being who gave Weiss authority to interfere with time... Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: That's all I can say about that being. I could say more when speaking with the goddess, but otherwise I cannot. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Please understand. Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood, hoot. I mean, understood.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Sigh, hoot. Listen to me ramble. Now that you've come this far, you must have felt something. Hoot?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel strange...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Every time I shook off or faced the spirits, I felt emotions I couldn't understand.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I'm glad you felt them, hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: But it's still not enough. I can't decide whether to stop Chronos's Time. Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what must I do?
(At %s's question, Chronos furrows his brow.)

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Honestly, it makes no difference to me whether you meet Lady Gaia. But Lady Iris went to such trouble to send you. You can't simply leave. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I know you came here with resolve. You also know earning permission isn't easy, don't you? Hoot?
(As %s nods silently, Chronos smiles faintly.)

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I'll test your courage.
(Chronos lifts his wings toward the sky. The realm of time trembles, and he cries out to summon the spirits.)

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: HOOOOOT!!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Hoot...
(Chronos suddenly stops moving and backs away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chronos?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I'll stop here. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: There's no point in fighting anymore. This will do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Chronos!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: But I won't stop time. Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you won't stop it, then...?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I'll slow it down, hoot. I could stop it, but Pneuma would collapse.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: As I said, if a villain exploits that opening, terrible things could happen. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: With so many ancient gods gone, Etoile and this world are still incomplete. Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: You said you felt many things while meeting the spirits, didn't you? Hoot?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Chronos.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: What you felt were emotions. All the emotions of lives that experience time...

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Countless people's feelings ride the flow of time to Pneuma. Hoot. How they arrive is top-secret spirit business. Hoot!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I can't make it sound as charming as Arche, but it's a secret anyway. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Strong yet uneasy, joyful yet afraid, happy yet tired. Those complex, subtle feelings...

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: It may seem obvious, but this 'time' Pneuma's spirits protect exists for the everyday lives of Etoile's inhabitants. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: These spirits guard it so those lives can continue to feel positive emotions. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Pneuma exists to protect such things. Hoot. If we stopped it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something terrible would happen, right?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Perhaps villains even the goddesses don't know about would slip in again. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Don't look so startled. You've proven your resolve. Hoot. Wait a moment.
(Chronos raises his wings to the sky once more. The energetic spirits gradually slow their movements.)

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I've slowed time here for now. I'll hold it like this.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Go to Kairos and tell him your resolve. He's prickly, so it won't be easy. Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Chronos!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: It's been so long since he saw a human that he may be flustered, too. Hoot...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche said it had been a long time since she'd seen one, too.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Arche was the second. You're the third. Hoot. I don't know who the first was. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: We're done here, so I'm getting back to work. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: If Lady Iris visits someday, I'll tell her. But she's not an ancient god, so coming here would take a great deal of preparation. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I'm a splendid spirit who focuses on his work. Hoot!
(Chronos suddenly looks toward the sky and frowns.)

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I have a lot to do. I must go at once. Head straight back to Arche. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Value your time. Hoot!
(Chronos beats his wings hurriedly and flies swiftly across the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel bad. I think I've made more work for him. I'd better head out, too.

steps.name: For a Special Moment
steps.objective: Defeat [Kairos] in 「Kairos's Time」 and obtain the <Rainbow Hourglass>. Then turn in the quest to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Did Chronos grant permission? The spirits are moving more slowly.
(Arche watches the nearby spirits, then notices a change in Pneuma's scenery.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: A rainbow? Oh... So rainbows appear here, too.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I've been here so long, but I've never seen one.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Ah, a rainbow... Wait. Rainbows, I... That is...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I didn't look like this back then... Calm down, Arche...
(As Arche struggles with her confusion, %s appears in the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, I'm back. Chronos told me to come here. Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'm... fine. What could possibly be wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What's with this silence...?)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If Chronos said that, you must have earned his permission!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. But Kairos won't be an easy opponent, you said?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: That's right. He's quite a formidable spirit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is he, then? Oh, is that a secret, too?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: This isn't a secret. The way to Kairos's Time... Do you see that hourglass over there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The hourglass? Yes. Don't tell me that's the entrance.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes. Approach it, and you'll naturally enter.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: While Chronos maintains ordinary time, Kairos creates moments of destiny.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Those moments when you make special choices are his domain. Perhaps Kairos's efforts helped shape a moment when you made a choice, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm. Arche seems fine.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Could you wait a moment?
(Arche takes a small bottle from between the rocks and carefully sprays it around %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Perfume?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: A kind of perfume made from the leaves of silver vine growing in Pneuma. It's the most effective way to summon Kairos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I suppose meeting a time spirit takes this sort of preparation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go see him.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Take care.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There shouldn't be any trouble...)
(After seeing the visitor off, Arche gazes again at the rainbow in the sky.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The rainbow reminds me of traveling with Lady Gaia. Ah...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I didn't have this form then...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Is that why %s felt so familiar...?
(As you approach the hourglass, the scenery slowly changes, as though you are entering another realm.)
(Small waterways wind between multicolored sand dunes, surrounded by trees with deep red leaves.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Both places really are realms of time. A pendulum clock there, hourglasses here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. That isn't sand inside the glasses. Is it water? Water is flowing from the broken ones.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd better watch my step.
Time flows like water, and no one can hold it. That's why it looks like that here. Yaaawn...
(Turning toward the voice, you see something enormous perched in a tree.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's that?
What do you think? Never seen a spirit before?
(The self-described spirit drops from the tree and lands.)
Thud.
(The being that lands with a heavy thump is an enormous cat in a gown-like dress, holding a throwing star in one paw.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A cat? No, wait... A Beastman?
Never seen a spirit before, hmm?
(The cat who claims to be a spirit looks thoroughly displeased, then suddenly rubs his face with a paw.)
You're not confusing me with Pasiphae, who only has the ears and tail, are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know Pasiphae?
Let's call her a distant relative. That's not important right now. You've got business with me, haven't you?
Ah, introductions. I'm Kairos. You're %s, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I've come to see Lady Gaia...

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Speak casually, like you did with Chronos. But... sniff, sniff. You've got a smell. Did you spray on silver vine perfume?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Arche told you to wear it?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I don't get enough sleep as it is, and that powerful scent woke me right up. What a chore she's given me... Listen, %s...

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Do you absolutely have to see Lady Gaia?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's why I came...

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Sigh... Arche always brings out the silver vine perfume when she wants me to work. Always saying it's a secret... As though I weren't short of sleep already...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Does Kairos like the scent of silver vine?)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Even if it's for Lady Gaia, even if Arche asks, I can't treat time carelessly.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: This place creates special moments within the time allotted to every life. If time stopped here...?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I don't even want to think about it. Though it never has stopped...

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Chronos giving permission doesn't mean I will. You'll have to earn my approval, too.
(Kairos leaps lightly onto a large branch.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: If this is destiny, so be it. Just like in Chronos's Time, now that you've decided to change time...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The spirits will try to stop me again?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Yes. This space will test you. To see how worthy you are of this moment...

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I'll appear when the test is nearly over. Meanwhile, I'll catch up on sleep. That silver vine woke me up. It's so strong it could clear a blocked nose.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Yaaawn... See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kairos, wait...
(Apparently never intending to listen, Kairos leaps away and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He could have listened a little longer. Oh... Is this how people feel when I rush off...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should experience it directly, just like before. Nothing to do but try...
(As though following an agreed signal, the pursuing spirits stop and disappear.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what...?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Yaaawn. No trouble getting here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kairos, where did you come from?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I was sleeping up there. But that silver vine scent is too strong. I couldn't sleep at all.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: The spirits seem to understand you now, so they backed off. I haven't.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: That expression tells me you certainly felt the flow of time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel strange...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm scared... Afraid...

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: In Chronos's Time, the feelings were about everyday things. Their range wouldn't have been so wide.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: But it's different here.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Ordinary time and moments of choice... Let's say they're a paper's width apart. You may regret a choice, or think it was an excellent one.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Such time comes equally to every being in Etoile. Using it well is up to each of them.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Do you still feel that way?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A little...
(Kairos pats %s's shoulder comfortingly.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: There. A cat's paw has a healing touch. How's that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel better.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Your moments of choice must have been difficult. All living things are incomplete, but you...

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Oop...!
(Kairos abruptly covers his mouth.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Nothing. What am I saying? Nonsense, that's all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't pretend you don't know. Tell me.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Sigh. No helping it, then.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: This, too, must be an unavoidable moment of choice. Fight me. If the outcome is your victory, perhaps I'll have something to tell you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this destiny, too?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: No. There is no destiny in this space. Only the course set by choices, and the results that follow.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: In time, you'll understand whether it was destiny...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's nothing else to my choice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I only came to do what I can.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Really?
(Seeing %s's resolve, Kairos's eyes sharpen.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Then you'll have to face me properly.
(Each time Kairos's and %s's attacks collide, water pooled on the ground sprays into the air.)
(Then, sensing something strange, Kairos retreats and raises a paw.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Stop a moment, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I think this will do. I've kept you too long.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Chronos has never slowed time before, so I didn't know. To think it would affect this place, too...

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Wait a moment.
(At Kairos's words, the spirits within begin to move more slowly.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I have to match Chronos's realm. Otherwise, this place will become unstable. Oh, and...
(Kairos looks around, then lifts an hourglass. Water and sand mingle inside, but unlike the others here, it shines with many colors.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Give this to Arche.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An hourglass?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: ...You have my permission to take it outside. It should open a way for you to meet Lady Gaia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then tell me what you promised.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Aww. I was hoping to send you off without that... All right, I'll tell you. It's a secret, but I was the one who slipped up.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Your soul is more special than anyone else's. I can't explain it in words... I don't know exactly how it's special...

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: It simply is. That must be why you've met so many gods and could come here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's all?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...It felt like there was something more important.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: That's everything. I only manage time. Now, don't you have Lady Gaia to visit?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I hope your choice proves right. Go on, back to Arche.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well... All right. I will.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: You must do it before time returns to its normal speed. Otherwise, you'll be forced back without accomplishing anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood. I'll go straight to Arche.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: The way to Arche is over there. Leave that way, and you'll see her soon.
(Kairos ushers %s outside with a paw against their back.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Arche, guide %s's footsteps to Lady Gaia.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: ...The spirits' movements have changed in Kairos's Time, too. Then... %s must have...
(Looking around, Arche spots %s returning.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, I'm back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kairos told me to give you this. How do I see Lady Gaia now?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: What is it?
(Arche takes the hourglass from %s and falls silent.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: A rainbow-colored hourglass...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It held water and sand, but now it's full of different colors. When did that happen...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Red through violet? A rainbow?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: A rainbow...
(Arche looks back and forth between the hourglass and the rainbow in the sky.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The reason Lady Gaia brought me here...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The reason I had to be here...
(Murmuring to herself, Arche quietly lets the hourglass fall.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche?
(Rainbow light pours from the broken hourglass and begins to swirl around Arche.)
(Then it rises into the sky and gently touches the rainbow.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Seeing the rainbow, I think there are no secrets left for me, either. Before you go to Lady Gaia, would you hear my story?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's important, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes. I'm practically a key myself. Oh, not a key in that other sense. Or perhaps there was that, too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A key...)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Only by unlocking my memories scattered through Pneuma can you reach Lady Gaia. It's the path I chose for her sake...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The story of two lives...

steps.name: Arche's Past
steps.objective: Follow [Arche] in 「Pneuma」 to view the story of the past. Then turn in the quest to [Arche] in 「Rainbow's End」.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It was no coincidence that I met you, recognized you, and was glad to see you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...You'll have to explain. I don't understand.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'll tell you everything.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Though I don't know whether Lady Iris would want to hear my story...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Iris and I can accept whatever you have to tell us.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I truly hope so.
(Arche quietly takes %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Then please hear my story.
(Holding %s's hand, Arche walks slowly onward. A beach utterly unlike Pneuma comes into view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The name you know for this place is the 'Wailing Coast,' isn't it, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... The Tower of Collapse is just ahead.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Where Lord Njord stayed.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Then let me tell you what happened here long ago.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Many members of the Tyr tribe were here. It was the time when we had to make a decision for the world, for Lady Seres...
(Arche looks toward the sky with sorrowful eyes.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: We all shared the same resolve, but its strength differed a little in each of us.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Even for the future's sake, the terror a small life felt was immense.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: One soul could not merge with the Beast... Its heart wasn't strong enough...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It was a young girl's soul.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Her name was Arche. That girl is me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Tyr tribe...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: During the fusion, my soul was badly wounded and cast out. I wanted to join them again, but the darkness swallowed me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never expected to hear a story like this.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I don't know where it was, but just before my soul vanished, Lady Gaia pulled me out. She held me, saying I didn't belong there...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: But then someone attacked her. She sent me somewhere safe, promising to find me again someday...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: And eventually, she did...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: That is where the memories of my first life end.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could it be...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, nothing.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Quite a shock, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Then... Shall we go somewhere else? Follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is Moros...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Even before the Kingdom of Moss occupied Moros, many people fought here. Eastland has been full of conflicts since long ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know this place, Arche?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's where I came from in my second life. I was born in a village in Oneiro Forest.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Back then, I wanted to become stronger, whatever it took. I couldn't remember my first life... Only the feeling that I'd been unable to help.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: So I trained hard with a sword, alone. But my strength was barely enough to withstand the dangers threatening the village...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Then a mage came to see me. I still remember the first thing she said.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: 'Oh, you're a boy?'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, Arche. You were a boy then?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Ahaha. Apparently so.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The mage said I could grow stronger if I trained as she instructed. In truth, it meant borrowing a god's power...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: To become stronger, I followed her through Eastland and Freios, accomplishing many things. Little by little, I grew.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I met many people and protected many people.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Then, while the mage was briefly away, I met a boy wearing a hat on a battlefield. He looked at me and said something strange.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: 'I can't let you become a key. You have the soul the sinner is waiting for...'

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: 'Your sacrifice will keep things from happening for a while.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sacrifice? A key?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: With those words, the boy became an enormous beast and bit my throat...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: That is where the memories of my second life end.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait... That story...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes. The power of the Orb Panel you used, %s. Those were records of my life.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: My name then was Weaver...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The mage returned, gathered up my dead body, and sent me here.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Lady Gaia...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's so complicated. I can't make sense of it all...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I know this is bewildering. But I had to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you were a Tyr soul that couldn't merge, and Lady Gaia saved you? Then you were reborn as a boy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You trained with Lady Gaia in the guise of a mage... So you're the ancient Champion boy I knew of?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: A Champion, yes, but not ancient. It was a little before the other Champions' time, except Lord Atkina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And when you were Weaver, Arche... the Agasura Jeril bit you to death. Wait...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A key...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A soul buried in eternity, now awakened... That's what Weiss said. Arche fits the condition for his key, but I don't...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then why was I...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Jeril may have killed a Tyr because he's an Agasura, but that means he already knew what Weiss was planning...)
(Watching %s's troubled expression, Arche quietly takes their hand.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I think I know what you're thinking.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I didn't tell you my story to burden your heart, %s. Please don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. It seems what happened to me isn't unrelated to you...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Now you should meet Lady Gaia. We've arrived.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Where is she? I don't see her here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...

steps.name: Reunion with Gaia
steps.objective: Listen to [Arche] in 「Rainbow's End」, then enter the portal inside.

lines.text: (Spaces filled with an alien feeling rush past, blending scenery with the hazy traces of someone's memories.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This isn't Pneuma, or Arche's memories...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's the end of the rainbow.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I think a rainbow is the proper way to reach Pneuma. I don't remember clearly, but that's the feeling I have now.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Keep going that way. Lady Gaia will be there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come with me, Arche.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'd like to see her too, but I must stay here and watch over time.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'm all right here, but you can't stay long, adventurer. Once time resumes its normal flow, even Lady Gaia won't be able to help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll see her and return as quickly as I can.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'll wait here. Go speak with her.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Again... You don't have much time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll remember...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Lady Gaia...)
(Spaces filled with an alien feeling rush past, blending scenery with the hazy traces of someone's memories.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This isn't Pneuma, or Arche's memories...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's the end of the rainbow.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I think a rainbow is the proper way to reach Pneuma. I don't remember clearly, but that's the feeling I have now.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Keep going that way. Lady Gaia will be there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come with me, Arche.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'd like to see her too, but I must stay here and watch over time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll see her and return as quickly as I can.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'll wait here. Go speak with her.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Again... You don't have much time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll remember...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Lady Gaia...)
(In a space filled with tiny lights against darkness, like the cosmos itself, the goddess Gaia stands in the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Gaia.
(Gaia makes no movement, as though time has stopped.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Gaia...?
(At the repeated calls of her name, Gaia's still eyes begin to move and blink.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's me, %s... Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm fine. But how did you... No, humans can't come here... Ah, Iris...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: If you've come to see me here, Arche must have brought you.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: You met Chronos and Kairos, and heard Arche's whole story...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris is worried. You disappeared without a word.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry. I'll explain everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There's so much I want to ask Lady Gaia.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry. I had no choice. I intended to meet Iris and explain someday, but I don't know when that will be...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: As the time for my next sleep approached, I worried a great deal. About what I could do to stop Weiss, too.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: With my remaining strength, I couldn't reach the Purgatory of Weiss, who had built his power with magic stones for so long... So I gave that strength to Iris.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I knew how she and everyone else longed to protect the places dear to them...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks to you, we succeeded.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Normally, I would sleep in the place called my sanctum to recover. But someone's malice was pursuing me, and I had to withdraw...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: So I came here, where I hadn't visited in a long time.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: This is part of the place where the ancient gods awakened. Iris, who became the God of the Astral Realm in a human body, cannot approach it.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: If she did come... Beings who refuse to acknowledge her would threaten her.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: That's why I couldn't tell her...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Lady Gaia. Iris will understand.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: ...After Seres and the Tyr tribe disappeared, I learned that one soul was trapped. Arche.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: While drawing her soul out to protect it, I was attacked by a Twisted One. Believing we would meet again someday...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: With Atkina's help, the child reached Eastland.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: But to my surprise, she had become a boy named Weaver. It startled me, but I didn't mind.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I wanted the child to live happily, but Eastland was full of conflict.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Weaver naturally took up a sword and fought. To protect everyone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard you guided him toward becoming a Champion...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: ...I wanted to make him strong, as he wished. I imagined the things he would someday accomplish for this world...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I took the form of a human mage, helped him resolve many problems, and watched him grow stronger.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: But on the single day I was briefly away from him... An Agasura recognized Weaver and killed him...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Tyr souls killed by Agasuras cannot be reborn.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: That is the design of the being leading this world to destruction. Though there was an exception...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I wanted to save the soul I'd failed to protect twice, so I brought it here. Even knowing it could never be born human again...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I wanted Arche to enjoy life. I'm so sorry that this was all I could do from where I stood...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Gaia, Arche will understand, too.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Now I'll explain the part that concerns you, %s.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I believed the experiences Arche had as Weaver would someday be needed by the one who would become Etoile's God of the Astral Realm.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: So I gathered them in an orb and waited for its owner to appear. I'm glad it reached you, %s, who believes in Iris and comforts her...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Thank you, once again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please, Lady Gaia...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: A soul buried in eternity, now awakened...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Weiss said that. It seems connected to what Jeril said when he bit Arche to death as Weaver.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: So Jeril knew about Weiss beforehand. And knew Arche met that condition...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. So please tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did I meet the conditions to become the key to Purgatory's door?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: You may remember something I once told you.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: That every being with a soul is incomplete. Even I, whom living things call a god...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: But your soul, %s, is not merely incomplete. It is unstable.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then shouldn't I fail to meet the conditions for the key?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: There are times and spaces even the ancient gods do not know, in Etoile and elsewhere.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: There are unusually many such possibilities surrounding you, %s. And you already know it.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: The you of another time...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Incomplete and unstable, yet the same soul continues to exist across many different times. The Agasuras can sense it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's hard to believe, but... I can imagine it being possible...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Agasuras are beings designed that way... Even the ancient gods' powers cannot reveal where they are or what they are doing.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Lady Gaia... Please don't apologize.
(Gaia looks a little strained.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right, Lady Gaia?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm fine. But I think our time is up...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Already...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Please continue to protect Iris. No... Stay by her side.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Minuet will be all right. Please speak to her from time to time... And tell her I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'll return as soon as I can. Ah, I owe Ouroboros a small debt in that regard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ouroboros?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: He may appear sooner than expected.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: He seems to be doing something, though for whose sake, even that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Lady Gaia.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Until we meet again... And thank you, always.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Don't worry too much. I'll come back well...
(With Gaia's farewell, the air flowing at the rainbow's end falls still. Gaia, too, ceases to move, as though her time has stopped.)
(But the goddess's butterfly must still see the adventurer off. It flies over and guides them outside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Gaia...

steps.name: To Iris…
steps.objective: Talk to [Arche] in 「Rainbow's End」 to return to [Iris] and complete the quest.

lines.text: (As %s slowly emerges from the rainbow's end, Arche's waiting eyes tremble slightly.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You're back, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... She was worried about everyone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly tell Arche about your conversation with Gaia.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Lady Gaia...
(Arche lowers her head, unable to speak. Only for a moment; then she looks up with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: This place has no secrets left from you now, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You kept them for Pneuma's sake, didn't you?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes, though that wasn't my own intention. But it doesn't matter. It was all so Lady Gaia could protect everything...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Time has returned to normal, too. Can you feel it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An unfamiliar feeling is washing over me. This isn't something I knew... Could it be what Lady Gaia mentioned...?)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing. It wasn't that I could feel time. How should I put it...?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Perhaps it's because you just met Lady Gaia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is that it...?)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s, I'd like to keep seeing you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like that, too. But Pneuma isn't somewhere I can easily visit...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: That's true. It's a shame. Ah, it's time for you to go back...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It was a pleasure meeting you, %s.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Let me prepare for your return, %s.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Please give my regards to Lord Atkina. And I don't know whether you'll meet this Jeril, but...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Tell him I'm all right with him having killed me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It might be difficult to explain, and I don't know where I'll meet him... But I'll tell him.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you, %s. Now... Take my hand. I'll send you back.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Oh, and one more request.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Would you be my friend? I've wanted a human friend, someone other than a spirit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you're happy with me... Are you sure?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Of course. I'd love that. Hehe... Oh, you were with Lady Iris before coming here, weren't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Then this place's time will take you back to her, %s. Thank you for being my friend...
(As Arche takes %s's hand, bright lights approach from all around the rainbow's end and guide them away.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Huh...?
(With Arche's startled voice, Pneuma comes into view: the place where she originally stood.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is where you were before...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: What happened? Did something go wrong?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The spirits are moving normally again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: No, everything is perfectly normal. Though it's strange that Chronos and Kairos are here.
(As though they have been waiting, a sullen giant cat and owl-clock slowly step forward behind Arche.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Why, Arche? Don't want me here?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: %s, so you met Lady Gaia safely. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You two held me back, didn't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chronos and Kairos stopped us?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: We didn't stop you.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I don't know how it happened, but there's something you need to realize, %s. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Ah...
(Arche smiles faintly, apparently understanding.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know, Arche? Why am I the only one who doesn't...? Could someone explain?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's a secret.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Earlier, it was a secret because you didn't know. Now it's a secret even though you do?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a little annoying... But I really have to figure it out myself?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: A perfect moment of choice.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: If you've been making an effort, you'll realize it soon. Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No pressure, then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know what choice or moment you mean... But does this mean I can now travel back and forth to Pneuma...? Aaaaaah!!
(As soon as the words leave their mouth, hidden spirits gather before %s. Before the adventurer can even say goodbye, they lift them up and hurl them high into the sky.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Figured it out faster than I expected.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I haven't met many humans, but that one is certainly clever. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Will %s come again?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: A human who asked a god to come here of their own free will. Hoot. There's every chance of another visit.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Though that would mean more work to do.
(At Chronos and Kairos's words, Arche smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You think so...?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Arche, you'll have plenty to do here from now on. Hoot. Kairos, say something, too.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Yaaaaawn. Arche, I'm going to sleep. Oh, Chronos, turn off your alarm. You're noisy enough already. How am I supposed to sleep with that ringing, too?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: What, hoot?! I refuse!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Insulting my alarm is unforgivable! Hoot! I'll ring it every minute! You lazy cat, all you do is eat and sleep!

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: What did you say? Bring it on, barn owl!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I'm an eagle owl, hoot! No, an owl clock! Hoot!
(As Chronos and Kairos tumble into a fight, Arche quietly looks at the sky where the rainbow has vanished.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Lady Gaia...
(Iris quietly surveys her surroundings. Sensing something unusual, she quickly stretches out both arms.)
(A moment later, the adventurer drifts gently into Iris's arms, light as a feather.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh... I feel strange. Oh, Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank goodness. I caught you as you fell...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Huh...?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaah! Sorry!
(Coming to their senses, the startled adventurer retreats as though fleeing.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Why are you so surprised?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Th-thank you.
(Iris looks at %s with a mischievous expression.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: So, how is Lady Gaia?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. She's well. She asked me to give you her regards... What she said was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Iris what happened in Pneuma: meeting Arche and the time spirits, and reaching Gaia with their help.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Lady Gaia... For my sake...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I didn't know. That that was her intention...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Or that I, born human and now here, could not go to that place...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: She did it all for me... I feel so sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. She said she'll return. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: For her sake, I won't let myself become too downhearted.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Aren't you tired?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure. It feels like I was there a long time, but also like a very short visit.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Really? Hehe...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: ...I still can't go, but you can visit Pneuma now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? Is it really all right to go back and forth?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: A path has opened in Eidos. You should be able to go through there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, I have a request.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's something I can do, of course.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: ...I'd just like to talk for a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like that. What should we talk about? Hmm, what would be good...?
(The conversation between Iris and the adventurer begins with little laughs and ends filled with hearty laughter.)
(After some time, seeing how tired the adventurer looks, Iris sends them home.)
(Once the adventurer leaves, Iris gazes blankly at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Lady Seres... My choice is all right, isn't it?
